programs.label: Memorization & Revision
programs.description: A staged memorization pathway building the Qur'an into long-term memory through structured memorization and revision cycles. Open to every student — no reading requirement.

levels.name: Juz Amma (Juz 30)
levels.desc: All 37 surahs of Juz 30 memorized with correct tajweed.

levels.name: Juz 29 & Core Surahs
levels.desc: Juz 29 plus the high-value surah bank (Yasin, Al-Mulk, Al-Waqi'ah, Al-Kahf).

levels.name: Half-Qur'an Memorization
levels.desc: Fifteen additional juz under a personal revision system.

levels.name: Complete Hifz (Khatm)
levels.desc: The entire Qur'an memorized, examined and publicly demonstrated.
